blocking_findings.violation: security-practices.md 'File System Security' table documents ~/.codemie/logs/ must be created with mode 0o700; this handler creates the directory with mkdir(dirname(logPath), {recursive:true}) and no mode, then appends the raw hook payload (potentially containing prompt/tool content) to hook-events.jsonl inside it
blocking_findings.why_blocking: a documented restrictive-permission requirement for this exact directory is not met for the new OTLP event log, leaving analytics payload data group/world-readable under the process umask
blocking_findings.remedy: pass {recursive:true, mode:0o700} to mkdir (or ensure getCodemiePath()'s logs directory is created with 0o700 before this handler writes to it) and mode:0o600 on the appended file
